name: TEAM ORDERS
note: The teams on the Formula 1 grid

clues.clue: In 2021 the name of this British carmaker, James Bond's favorite, returned to the grid after 61 years
In 2024 this British team in papaya orange won its first constructors' crown since 1998
In 2026 this General Motors luxury brand became the first brand-new team on the grid in a decade
This Volkswagen Group brand from Ingolstadt took over the Sauber team to enter Formula 1 in 2026
In 2021 Renault renamed its F1 team for this sports-car brand of its own, itself named for mountains
